scope: Educational finite qualification using unchanged original simulator. Normal outcomes vs fixed R1+R10, not a test of hidden conditions. All normal gates must pass before paired release impacts are run. The frozen baseline itself has gain zero and does not pass the new-handoff gate.
normal_gates: All four G4 physics gates vs R1; original-path TCP RMS/max, both torque steps and placing peak all <=1.05 times R1; no extra actuator saturation or unmatched normal FA (one-to-one within 20 ms), no lost true tool-contact hit and no additional tool pre-alarm. Missing/unscorable data cannot pass.
impact_gates: Relative to each controller's own matched no-impact trace: distinguishable old detections may not be lost nor delayed >5ms. No unmatched false alarms (one-to-one within 20 ms), no additional prealarm or lost tool hit, identical physical input and exact pre-pulse q/tau/alarms. A normal alarm near the artificial pulse is not a detection. All probe outcomes must be distinguishable for a finite all-probe pass; retaining a miss is not solving one.
